items.finding: One multi-part message was stored as N clause rows (clause texts, clause answers) while the user saw one combined answer; the combined answer was never stored. Proven effects: duplicate visible history rows; the stored user text differs from what was typed; a consumer "short version" request would shorten only the last clause answer; follow-ups after a no-record clause found no result set for it. Not proven: duplicate workflow or action state (one pending workflow; cancel is terminal), wrong turn ordering, wrong reference ownership.
items.fix: collapseMultipartExchange (canonical persistence): folds the sub-turn message rows into one exchange (typed message, combined answer); an action turn keeps its own rows; result sets and workflow state untouched.
